reason: Both conversations correctly identified 4C as a water supply fault, asked the right first questions, and resolved it by having the homeowner open the closed isolation valve with no parts or escalation. Conversation 2 was marginally sharper: it added a sensible check of the kitchen tap flow to separate a plumbing supply problem from the dishwasher, and gave clear, practical guidance on using a flat screwdriver and the open position. Conversation 1 attached an image about the base/drain filter, which is irrelevant to a fill fault and could have sent the homeowner looking in the wrong place; otherwise its advice was equally correct.
